decisions.reason: The two-component resin injection unit fits the firm's core injection business and has its own page in its launch year, which signals results near aspiration. A medium-sized established firm has enough slack to carry it while results are still uncertain.
This is a second injection unit in the same line, so some overlap with A is possible. There is no evidence of a shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of the resources, so it is kept.
Automatic airless spray guns are a core accessory for the firm's spray systems and are likely to meet aspirations based on past gun sales.
Manual airless guns are a staple product with steady demand from coating and construction users, so results should be satisfactory.
This multi-model air-assisted airless gun line extends the core spray portfolio, and its breadth indicates commitment and expected adequate performance.
The data logger is a less proven digital add-on whose results are uncertain. Organisational slack and the firm's stated aim to develop innovative application technology support keeping it for now.
